itinerary.stay: Cozy Mountain Homestay / Guest House (Triple sharing)
itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri Village (Drive Day)
itinerary.subtitle: Scenic mountain drive alongside the Yamuna & Tons Rivers
highlights: Evening briefing & gear inspection in Sankri
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dehradun Railway Station by 6:30 AM. Board our pre-booked tempo traveler for a scenic 8-hour drive through Mussoorie, Nainbagh, Damta, Purola, and Mori. Enter the Govind Wildlife Sanctuary and reach the charming village of Sankri by late afternoon. Check into your cozy mountain homestay, enjoy hot chai with pakodas, followed by a detailed trek briefing by your Trek Leader.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Juda Ka Talab Campsite
itinerary.subtitle: Trek through dense pine, oak, and maple forest trails
highlights: Frozen/pristine alpine lake of Juda Ka Talab
itinerary.description: Wake up to the crisp Himalayan air. After a hearty breakfast, begin the trek towards Juda Ka Talab. The trail ascends gently through thick pine forests adorned with pine cones and golden maple leaves. Hear the gushing streams and cross wooden bridges. Reach the iconic Juda Ka Talab lake nestled between giant fir trees. Set up camp and enjoy a warm dinner under a blanket of sparkling stars.

itinerary.title: Juda Ka Talab to Kedarkantha Base Camp
itinerary.subtitle: Open meadows and breathtaking views of towering snow peaks
highlights: Breaching the timberline into vast meadows
Unobstructed view of the Kedarkantha summit cone
itinerary.description: Start your morning with gentle stretching and hot ginger tea. Today is a relatively short but steep climb leading out of the tree line into wide open alpine meadows. As you climb, majestic peaks like Bandarpoonch, Swargarohini, and Kala Nag start emerging on the horizon. Arrive at Kedarkantha Basecamp by lunch. Relax, do summit acclimatization walks, and sleep early for the midnight summit push!

itinerary.title: Base Camp to Kedarkantha Summit & Descend to Hargaon
itinerary.subtitle: The grand summit push at dawn with 360-degree Himalayan sunrise
highlights: Celebratory hot gulab jamun at camp
itinerary.description: Wake up at 3:00 AM under starlight. Equip your headlamps and microspikes, and begin the thrilling ascent to the summit. As dawn breaks, witness golden rays painting the massive Himalayan range in shades of crimson and gold. Reach the summit (12,500 ft) marked by the Shiva shrine. Soak in the 360-degree panorama of DhaulaDhar, Kinnaur, and Garhwal peaks. Descend back to base for lunch and continue down to the scenic Hargaon campsite.

itinerary.title: Hargaon to Sankri & Drive back to Dehradun
itinerary.subtitle: Descent through village apple orchards and return journey
highlights: Distribution of official Trek Completion Certificates
itinerary.description: Enjoy your final breakfast in the mountains. Trek down through tranquil pine trails and apple orchards of Saur village, arriving back in Sankri by 10:30 AM. Freshen up, collect your stored luggage, and board the vehicles for Dehradun. Reach Dehradun Railway Station by 7:30 PM with unforgettable memories, new lifelong friends, and a summit certificate!

itinerary.stay: Boutique AC Hotel near the Ghats
itinerary.title: Arrival in Kashi, Assi Ghat & Grand Dashashwamedh Aarti
itinerary.subtitle: Welcome to Anandavana, explore Assi Ghat and watch the grand evening aarti from the river
highlights: Dashashwamedh Ghat Maha Aarti from private boat
Floating diya ceremony on the Ganges
itinerary.description: Arrive at Varanasi Cantt Railway Station or Airport and transfer to our boutique hotel near the ghats. Freshen up and begin exploring Assi Ghat. Try lemon tea and woodfired pizza at famous riverside cafes. In the evening, board our private wooden boat on the Ganges. Position directly in front of Dashashwamedh Ghat to witness the breathtaking Grand Ganga Aarti performed with giant multi-tiered brass lamps, conch shells, and rhythmic Vedic chants. Float earthen diyas upon the sacred waters.

itinerary.stay: Boutique AC Hotel near the Ghats
itinerary.title: Subah-e-Banaras Sunrise Cruise, Kashi Vishwanath Corridor & Sarnath
itinerary.subtitle: Watch morning rituals from boat, visit the Golden Temple & Buddhist cradle
itinerary.description: Wake up at 5:30 AM for the legendary "Subah-e-Banaras" sunrise boat cruise. Watch the crimson sun rise over the holy river as pilgrims perform morning prayers along the 84 ghats. Pass by the historic Harishchandra and Manikarnika Ghats. Return for breakfast, then proceed for Darshan at the magnificent Kashi Vishwanath Golden Temple Corridor. Afternoon excursion to Sarnath to see the ancient Dhamek Stupa and Ashoka Pillar. Evening Banarasi street food crawl: Tamatar Chaat at Kashi Chaat Bhandar, winter Malaiyyo, and Banarasi Paan.

itinerary.title: Kaal Bhairav Temple, Silk Weaving Heritage & Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Blessings of Kotwal of Kashi, visit traditional Banarasi silk looms & farewell
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the fierce protector deity of Kashi—the Kaal Bhairav Mandir. Take a guided walking tour through the narrow alleyways (galis) to see master weavers crafting world-famous Banarasi silk sarees on traditional handlooms. Savor a final kulhad lassi and purchase authentic Banarasi souvenirs. Transfer to Varanasi Cantt Station or Airport for departure with peace and spiritual elevation.

reviews.name: Aakash Sharma
reviews.title: Summit Push at 3 AM was Unreal!
reviews.comment: Kedarkantha with RoamX was by far the best mountain experience of my life! Our Trek Captain Rohan made sure everyone felt safe even during the 3 AM summit push in knee-deep snow. The food at 11,000 ft was hot and delicious.

reviews.name: Pooja Hegde
reviews.title: Flawless Logistics & Magic at Juda Ka Talab
reviews.comment: The departure city bus coordination from Delhi to Sankri was seamless! Clean homestays, high-grade microspikes provided without extra rent, and the midnight stargazing at Juda Ka Talab was pure magic.

reviews.name: Varun Verma
reviews.title: Frozen Spiti in 4x4 - Unmatched Adventure
reviews.comment: Spiti in 4x4 with RoamX is legendary! Reaching Hikkim and sending postcards at -10°C, drinking butter tea with local families, and crossing the Chicham bridge. 10/10 execution!

reviews.name: Sneha Roy
reviews.title: Safest & Best Solo Trip Experience
reviews.comment: Solo female traveler here and felt 100% comfortable and welcomed in the group. The flexible booking token and clear packing guides made planning this trip so effortless.

reviews.name: Ananya Deshmukh
reviews.title: Mana Village & Badrinath were divine!
reviews.comment: The Badrinath expedition exceeded all expectations. Standing at Mana, India's last village, tasting tea at the last tea shop, and the peaceful trek to Vasudhara Falls was pure magic. Our trip captain took utmost care of altitude safety.
reviews.tripName: Badrinath Yatra & Mana India's Last Village Expedition

reviews.name: Kabir Singhania
reviews.title: Rafting + Landour Bakehouse is the Best Combo
reviews.comment: Grade-III river rafting in Rishikesh followed by lemon crepes at Landour Bakehouse and sunset at George Everest peak. The tempo traveler was super comfortable and the team vibes were electric!

reviews.name: Riddhi Kulkarni
reviews.title: Subah-e-Banaras Boat Ride was Unforgettable
reviews.comment: The sunrise wooden boat cruise across the 84 ghats of Kashi and the grand evening Aarti from the boat was spiritual bliss. Amazing street food crawl too—the Malaiyyo and Banarasi Paan were out of this world!
